evidence.note: The validator found no signature on the Response or the Assertion. The SP requires a signed Assertion.

output.fix: In the Entra enterprise app, go to Single sign-on > SAML Certificates > Edit, and set Signing Option to "Sign SAML response and assertion". Signing the assertion alone also satisfies this SP. Keep the SP's signed-assertion requirement. After the change, capture a new response and re-validate it. The signature should then verify against the configured IdP certificate.
